verdict.rationale: Vanta has dedicated first-party product pages for HIPAA (automated evidence and guided controls for the Security and Breach Notification Rules), GDPR (privacy workflows and continuous monitoring), and PCI (reuse controls and track progress in one place). Its GRC page describes cross-mapping controls across many pre-built frameworks on one platform, and the API filters documents and evidence by framework. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-framework use, detail on PCI DSS-specific coverage (the PCI page is generic), and a concrete framework count (the source shows only a placeholder).
